title: viburnum atrocyaneum subsp. harryanum
intro: Viburnum atrocyaneum subsp. harryanum, commonly known as Himalayan Cranberry, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region. It has been traditionally used in medicine due to its various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include wound healing, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Viburnum atrocyaneum subsp. harryanum also exhibit antioxidant and free radical scavenging activities, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
